abstract: Seventeen cases of abdominal teratoma were studied retrospectively. These patients had been diagnosed at Cathay General Hospital from 1978 to 1993. The male to female ratio was 9:8, the range of age at diagnosis was from 2 days to 13 years. The chief complaints were palpable abdominal mass in 13 patients (76%) and abdominal distention in 7 (41%). Fifteen teratomas were located in the retroperitonium; also, 1 of the 17 had gastric teratoma and another, a tumor originating from an undescended testes. The tumors were resected in all patients. Postoperative courses were smooth except for one patient, who died suddenly on the day following surgery. No further specific management was needed because the pathologic findings were all benign in nature. Ultrasonography is of benefit in locating, as well as diagnosing, abdominal teratoma. Surgical excision is curative for the majority of cases. Long term follow-up is necessary, in consideration of the rare chance of recurrence.
abstract_ja: 1978年から1993年にかけてCathay General Hospitalで診断された腹部奇形腫17例を後方視的に検討した。男女比は9:8、診断時年齢は生後2日から13歳であった。主訴は腹部腫瘤が13例（76%）、腹部膨満が7例（41%）であった。奇形腫17例中15例は後腹膜に位置し、1例は胃奇形腫、もう1例は停留精巣由来の腫瘍であった。全例で腫瘍切除が行われた。術後経過は、1例が術翌日に突然死した以外は良好であった。病理学的所見はいずれも良性であったため、それ以上の特異的治療は必要なかった。超音波検査は腹部奇形腫の局在診断および診断に有用である。外科的切除は大半の症例で根治的である。再発の可能性は稀であるが、長期フォローアップが必要である。
